headline: MIA @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 5.23 at COL 4.16, with a projected total of 9.40. Batter research is strongest for Jake McCarthy, TJ Rumfield, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brian Navarreto, Heriberto Hernández because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
